title: Subset local correction tester
statement: For each $n\ge 0$ and each subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define a three-query tester on sign-valued functions on the Boolean cube. It samples a Boolean-cube point $y$ uniformly, queries at the sign-embedded points corresponding to $y$ and $x+y$, where $x$ is the sign embedding of the indicator vector of $S$, and leaves the third query unused. It accepts exactly when the first two answers are present and have product $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinate indices
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the subset-indicator sign vector or the sign embedding, so their exact conventions are unavailable.
